about: The tasks Luis asked for in co-play session 1 (docs/RETRO-2026-11-01-coplay.md scorecard, 17 rows, ~14 distinct), as windows on the brain log with a game-evidence check and the steps a person would take. tools/standard_score.py coplay scores them to the human standard; `retro` is the retro's verdict, which the scorer never reads (agreement only). Times are UTC on `date`. t0 = Luis's request line; t1 = when he moved on. check: {tool (regex, full match), ok, item (regex over args/data names), data {dotted key: regex}, args {key: value}, n (the n-th matching result) | last (the last one)}, {stat_ge {stat: value}} from consume results and vitals survival rows, {all|any [...]}, {never: true}. steps: [family, units] with T_h unit times from data/baselines/luis-*.json (else provisional), ["travel", metres | "auto" = the first trip's start-to-goal distance in the window].
